findings.evidenceJa: 元凶を叩いて止めさせる
findings.governingReading: strike down the source and force it to stop
findings.explanation: The urgent plan to defeat the responsible party and halt the field becomes vague retrieval of a “cause.”

findings.evidenceJa: 手分けして校舎を探そう
findings.governingReading: let us split up and search the school building
findings.explanation: Shirou’s risky proposal that they divide the search disappears.

findings.highlight: I grab Tohsaka, who’s still standing still, and run.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の手を引いて走り出す
findings.governingReading: I pull Rin by the hand and start running
findings.explanation: A relational hand-leading gesture becomes grabbing Rin herself.

findings.highlight: She says we should call for Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを呼ぶって言ったって
findings.governingReading: Even if we say we will call Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s internal objection to the idea becomes prior dialogue spoken by Rin.

findings.highlight: her usual cool isn’t there yet
findings.evidenceJa: 本来の冷静さは戻っていない
findings.governingReading: her native composure has not yet returned
findings.explanation: Rin’s impaired judgment becomes an awkward claim that her usual “cool” is absent.

findings.highlight: Saber should be able to beat that Servant
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは確実に勝利できる
findings.governingReading: Saber can defeat that Servant with certainty
findings.explanation: Shirou’s overconfident certainty is weakened to ordinary expectation.
Rin’s concrete mental model for releasing a Command Spell is flattened.

findings.highlight: eliminate any thoughts in my head
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=しこう char=2]雑念をクリアし
findings.governingReading: clear away distracting thoughts—read with the ruby “thought”
findings.explanation: The layered wording between distracting thoughts and thought itself disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 左手の甲が熱く焼ける
findings.governingReading: the back of my left hand burns hot
findings.explanation: The exact bodily site of Command Spell expenditure disappears.
The spatial deformation from which Saber manifests becomes an unrelated void.
Rin’s specific skill at reading residual magecraft becomes generic magic detection.

findings.highlight: my skill to detect magic is pretty good too
findings.evidenceJa: わたしだって負けてない
findings.governingReading: I am no worse when it comes to traces of magecraft
findings.explanation: Rin’s direct claim of parity is weakened to vague adequacy.

findings.highlight: I can’t say for sure, but that’s what I feel.
findings.evidenceJa: 断定はできないけど、わたしはそう感じてる
findings.governingReading: I cannot say for certain, but that is what I sense: the field’s origin is on the first floor
findings.explanation: The English immediately contradicts Rin’s explicit uncertainty with “has to be.”

findings.highlight: I have to use the Command Spell or we’ll have to wait for him to detect this and come here
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪を使うか、あいつがこっちの異状を感知して駆けつけてくる以外ない
findings.governingReading: Either I use a Command Spell, or he notices the abnormality here and rushes over
findings.explanation: The English invents passive waiting and weakens Archer’s independent detection and urgent arrival.
